item.title: Show HN: I built a faster, simpler Letterboxd alternative
item.summary: I always wanted a more intuitive movie watchlist app so I spent the last couple of weeks building one: https://www.queuebrick.com is a fast and elegantly simple movie (and tv) tracking app. I also built out a 1 to 1 native iOS app to go with it ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/queuebrick/id6793356756 (couple of small UI annoyances I’ve shipped fixes for, just waiting for app store review). You can also export your entire Letterboxd archive and immediately import it to Queuebrick with one click. There are some social components to it. There are more social components to it that I’ve intentionally hid for now because I don’t know if I care about them (reviews???). I don’t really have an end goal for the project, it kind of just exists now. It’s also all free, no ads, no tracking. Curious to hear your thoughts / critiques / requests etc. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49155930 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
